description:
Jabosi 10000mAh magnetic power bank with 15W wireless charging is made for people who want a slim MagSafe‑style snap‑on battery pack that charges while you scroll. Snap it onto compatible iPhones with MagSafe‑style alignment, or place any Qi-enabled phone on the pad for cable-free top-ups. With a full 10000mAh capacity, it’s built to rescue your battery on commutes, travel days, and long office hours—when your phone can’t die.

Need to watch, work, or video call while charging? Flip out the built-in foldable stand and set your phone at a comfortable angle in seconds. For faster or more reliable charging, use the USB‑C port for wired power and quick refills. Built-in protections against over-charge, over-discharge, and short circuit help keep charging safe and steady wherever you use it.
